_doc: THE canonical runner config (nb-ci controller, scripts/ci/mini-runner-labels.sh, tests). Isolation: auto repos (NB_CI_MODE=auto, repo variable overrides org) route to nb-auto / nb-deploy / nb-ctl, labels no legacy runner carries; legacy repos keep runner-vm / nb-route on today's runners, so neither side can take the other's jobs. One ephemeral VM per job, first class whose labels contain all of the job's labels. The fallback runner gets fallback_labels ADDED (its own labels untouched) only while GCP cannot start VMs. Mac Mini CI labels (ci_labels) are removed only after every repo is auto.

classes.name: control
classes._doc: route + notify jobs of auto repos (runs-on nb-ctl): the 2 runners on the always-on controller VM, no VM boot

classes.name: deploy
classes._doc: build + rsync / S3 release: standard VM, a preemption can never leave a partial deploy

classes.name: gate
classes._doc: fastest 8-vCPU Spot type the quota allows (us-central1 quotas 2026-11-27: C3 24, N2D 16, C2D 100): c2d-highcpu-8 so 32 vCPU = 4 concurrent jobs; change machine/vcpu/ram_gb/price here only. sa=ro: read-only npm-cache bucket token

prices_usd._doc: GCP Cloud Billing Catalog, us-central1, read 2026-11-26 (services/6F81-5844-456A). Per hour unless noted.

quota._doc: One budget for CI + AutoQA: deploy > gate > AutoQA. Gate VMs leave reserve_deploy_vcpu free; AutoQA gets what is left (published as project metadata nb-autoqa-vcpu-allowance).
